info.title: Outlaw Star
info.synopsis: Ci troviamo in un futuro denominato "Towards Stars Era" in cui molti sistemi stellari sono stati aperti al traffico spaziale. Gene Starwind e James Hawking gestiscono una piccola agenzia tuttofare e vengono ingaggiati per proteggere il capitano Hilda, che guida una nave spaziale, la XGP-15A II, soprannominata anche "Otlaw Star", alla ricerca di un leggendario luogo che custodisce un immenso tesoro.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Gene Starwind is a jack-of-all-trades stuck on a rundown planet with his partner, Jim. Without a ship to call his own, Gene is going nowhere fast. But things change when a mysterious woman shows up with a not-so-simple job.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: An outlaw, pirates, and a mysterious girl in a box. Before Gene can ask too many questions, he and Jim escape with Hilda to Blue Heaven. But this heaven is a hell filled with dangerous outlaws!

episodes.synopsis: As they work to lose McCoy’s forces, trouble comes in the form of the Ctarl-Ctarl Empire blocking their path. Despite this, Hilda gets them to where they need to be, only to learn disturbing news.
